description: The HUD window, which loads jarvis_hud.html — a page vendored from the backend folder and therefore not written against this app's IPC surface. It gets exactly ONE app command, `summon_push_to_talk` (the `hud-voice` set), for its mic button: it shows the quickbar with push-to-talk ready and records nothing, so the worst any drop of that page can do with it is open a window. It gets no recording, chat, approval or settings command. The shell otherwise talks to it one way, by evaluating a call to a feed the initialisation script defines. There is deliberately no `remote` block anywhere: every window loads a bundled page.
